hook.say: Spilled coffee on the couch? Don't scrub it yet.
hook.show: Spilled coffee on the couch? Don’t scrub it yet.

tip1.say: One. Blot, don't rub. Press a clean white cloth onto the spill, and lift.
tip1.show: Blot, don’t rub. Press a clean white cloth onto the spill, and lift.

tip2.say: Two. Check the care tag under the cushion. If the code is S, skip the water.
tip2.show: Check the care tag under the cushion. If the code is S, skip the water.

tip3.say: Three. Spot-test any cleaner on a hidden area, and let it dry before you treat the stain.
tip3.show: Spot-test any cleaner on a hidden area, and let it dry before you treat the stain.

cta.say: The full guide is on House Care Wiki dot com. Save this for the next spill.
cta.show: The full guide is on HouseCareWiki.com. Save this for the next spill.
